_comment: Settings for docs/reference/configuration.md. docs/_tools/generate_configuration.py takes the default of every AppConfig field from candyconc/config.py and checks that every other name is read by the code. This list covers the public configuration reference. The runtime also accepts internal, experimental, and compatibility settings.

groups.title: Language model for the copilot
groups.intro: The copilot is optional. Without `COPILOT_ENDPOINT` every other function works and the chat answers that no language model is configured. **Settings > Model connection** in the web interface changes endpoint, model, and key at once, until the server stops.

settings.name: COPILOT_ENDPOINT
settings.text: Address of an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, ending in `/v1/responses` or `/v1/chat/completions`, for example `http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1/responses` for a local server. Empty: no copilot.

settings.name: COPILOT_MODEL
settings.text: Model name that the endpoint expects. CandyConc checks the `model` field of every answer and stops with an error when the endpoint answers with a different model.

settings.name: COPILOT_API_KEY
settings.text: Key sent as `Authorization: Bearer` to the endpoint. Local servers usually accept any value.

settings.name: COPILOT_REASONING_EFFORT
settings.text: Reasoning effort (`low`, `medium`, `high`) for providers that support it. Unset: not sent.

settings.name: COPILOT_THINKING_MODE
settings.text: For models of the Qwen3 family: `off` adds `/no_think`, `on` adds `/think` to the question. Unset: unchanged.

groups.title: Passage search with a remote embedding model
groups.intro: These settings matter only for a corpus whose passage index was built with a remote embedding model. Similar words use the word vectors of the annotation pipeline of each corpus, see [Languages and annotation pipelines](languages.md#word-vectors).

settings.name: CANDYCONC_GEMMA_EMB_ENDPOINT
settings.text: OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint for passage search in such a corpus. The search text is sent to this endpoint.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_GEMMA_EMB_MODEL
settings.text: Model name for `CANDYCONC_GEMMA_EMB_ENDPOINT`.

groups.title: Corpus at start
groups.intro: Without these settings the server opens the active corpus of the corpus catalog, or the most recent corpus in the data directory.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_INDEX_PATH
settings.text: Directory of a corpus index that the server opens at every start. The server refuses to start when the directory is not a complete index. The HTTP API addresses this corpus with the name `default`, and the corpus catalog gives the folder name in `display_name`.

groups.title: Locations
groups.intro: `candy paths` prints the locations that are in effect. See [Where your data lives](../concepts/where-data-lives.md).

settings.name: CANDYCONC_HOME
settings.text: Data directory: corpora, corpus catalog, project file, preferences, logs, downloaded pipelines, temporary files.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_CONFIG_FILE
settings.text: Location of the configuration file. The default is `~/Library/Application Support/candyconc/config.toml` on macOS and `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/candyconc/config.toml` (usually `~/.config/candyconc/config.toml`) on Linux.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_PROJECT_FILE
settings.text: Project file with subcorpora, line annotations, and the coding scheme. Empty: `proj.ccproj` in the working directory if one exists there (older versions kept it there), otherwise `proj.ccproj` in the data directory. A relative path is resolved against the working directory.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_PROJECTS_DIR
settings.text: Directory with saved analyses, cluster lists, and project members. Empty: `config/projects` in the working directory if it exists there, otherwise `projects` in the data directory.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_PREFS_PATH
settings.text: File with the saved preferences of the web interface.

settings.name: index_dir
settings.text: Same as `CANDYCONC_INDEX_PATH`, as a setting of the configuration file (environment name `INDEX_DIR`). `CANDYCONC_INDEX_PATH` wins when both are set.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_FRONTEND_DIST
settings.text: Directory of a built web interface to serve instead of the one in the package. The directory must contain `index.html`.

groups.title: Security and access
groups.intro: The two security modes are described in [Deployment](deployment.md).

settings.name: CANDYCONC_SECURITY_MODE
settings.text: `local_dev_unsafe`: single-user mode, bound to the local computer, no sign-in. `release`: multi-user mode with sign-in, roles, host check, and without the OpenAPI pages.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_ENABLE_RBAC
settings.text: Role-based access control. Multi-user mode needs it. `candy --enable-rbac` sets it for one start.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_USER_FILE
settings.text: User file with password hashes and roles, written by `python -m candyconc.tools.user_bootstrap`. Multi-user mode does not start without at least one user. An absolute path is used directly. A relative path is first resolved from the installation. If that file is absent, CandyConc reads `users.json` from its data directory.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_TRUSTED_HOSTS
settings.text: Comma-separated host names that multi-user mode accepts in the `Host` header. Add the host name of your server or reverse proxy. `*` switches the check off.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS
settings.text: Lifetime of a sign-in token in seconds. `0`: tokens do not expire.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_ALLOW_UNSAFE_NETWORK_DEV
settings.text: `1` lets single-user mode bind to a network address. Without it, `candy --host 0.0.0.0` stops in single-user mode. Anyone who reaches the address then has full access.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_ENABLE_COPILOT_PII_MASK
settings.text: Replaces e-mail addresses, IBANs, and telephone numbers in the question and the interface context with placeholders before they reach the language model. It does not mask the tool results, which contain corpus text.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_ENABLE_PII_MASK
settings.text: Replaces concordance tokens with `<PII>` when their indexed entity label is recognized. Requires named entity annotations. Recognizes English labels such as `PERSON`, but not the German person label `PER`. This corpus-text masking is independent of `CANDYCONC_ENABLE_COPILOT_PII_MASK`. See [Languages and annotation](../concepts/languages-and-annotation.md).

settings.name: CANDYCONC_LOG_LEVEL
settings.text: Log level of the server: `DEBUG`, `INFO`, `WARNING`, or `ERROR`. `candy --log-level` sets it for one start.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_LOG_FILE
settings.text: File that receives the server log in addition to the terminal. `candy --log-file` sets it for one start.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_AUDIT_LOG_PATH
settings.text: Log of sign-ins, failed sign-ins, sign-outs, and WebSocket tickets, one JSON object per line, rotated at 5 MiB. `off` switches it off.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_ENABLE_LLM_TRACE
settings.text: Record of every call to the language model in `traces.jsonl` in the data directory: user, model, tool names, and for each message its role and size, without the text. Unset: on in single-user mode, off in multi-user mode.

groups.title: Request limits
groups.intro: Limits protect a shared server. A request above a limit receives an error, the server never shortens a result without saying so.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_RATE_LIMIT_ANON
settings.text: Requests per minute and client address without a token. `0`: no limit.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT
settings.text: Requests per minute and user with a token. `0`: no limit.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES
settings.text: Largest request body. Larger requests receive 413. `0`: no limit.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_QUERY_MAX_CONTEXT
settings.text: Largest context width, in tokens on each side of a hit.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_ANALYSIS_PAGE_LIMIT_MAX
settings.text: Largest page of result rows that one request may ask for.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_ANALYSIS_JOB_TOP_N_MAX
settings.text: Largest number of rows that an analysis job keeps.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_ANALYSIS_NGRAM_MAX_N
settings.text: Longest n-gram.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_ANALYSIS_COLLOCATE_MAX_WINDOW
settings.text: Largest collocation window, in tokens on each side.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_ANALYSIS_RESULT_MAX_BYTES
settings.text: Largest result of one analysis job, in bytes.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_ALIGNMENT_MAX_EDIT_CELLS
settings.text: Largest sentence alignment of paired texts, in comparisons. A larger alignment is refused, not shortened.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_MAX_REGEX_TYPES
settings.text: Largest number of distinct values matched by a regular expression when concordance lines are requested. Larger matches are rejected. Set this environment variable before starting the server.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_MAX_REGEX_FREQ
settings.text: Largest summed corpus frequency, in tokens, of the values matched by a regular expression when concordance lines are requested. Larger matches are rejected. Set this environment variable before starting the server.

groups.title: Copilot operation
groups.intro: The time limits are safeguards against a connection that hangs. A question can legitimately take long on slow hardware.

settings.name: COPILOT_TIMEOUT
settings.text: Time limit in seconds for one call to the language model. `0`: no limit.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_COPILOT_MAX_TIME_SEC
settings.text: Time budget in seconds for one copilot turn. Empty or `0`: no budget.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_LM_STUDIO_REQUIRE_LOADED_MODEL
settings.text: For endpoints on the local computer: check the model list of the endpoint before each question and answer 424 when the model is not loaded. The check never loads a model.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_MAX_COPILOT_STEPS
settings.text: Largest number of tool steps that one question may use. A client that requests more is limited to this value.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_COPILOT_MAX_QUESTION_CHARS
settings.text: Longest question in characters. Longer questions receive 413.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_COPILOT_MAX_MESSAGES
settings.text: Largest number of messages in one chat request.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_COPILOT_MAX_HISTORY_CHARS
settings.text: Largest total length of the messages in one chat request, in characters.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_MCP_URL
settings.text: Address of a remote CandyConc tool service. When set, the copilot sends every tool call with its arguments to `<address>/mcp/call` instead of running it in the server, and uses the results that come back. Leave it empty to run the tools in the server itself.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_MODEL_CONTEXT_TOKENS
settings.text: Context window of the model in tokens. CandyConc shortens the working record of a question in the model's copy before it outgrows this window. Set it to the context size of your model if that is smaller.

settings.name: COPILOT_RECIPE_CLASSIFIER_TIMEOUT_S
settings.text: Time limit in seconds of the model call that chooses the analysis recipe. Unset, the limit is 300 seconds. When it runs out, the question continues with the recipe from the keyword rules or without a recipe.

groups.title: Import
groups.intro: Before an import CandyConc estimates the disk space the index needs and refuses the import when the volume of the output directory has too little free space.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_BUILD_DISK_FACTOR
settings.text: Estimated index size as a multiple of the input size.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_BUILD_DISK_RESERVE_GB
settings.text: Free space in GB that must remain after the estimated index size.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_BUILD_ALLOW_LOW_DISK
settings.text: `1` turns the refusal into a warning.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_VERSION
settings.text: Label of a deployment that `GET /api/v1/system/info` reports instead of the package version.

settings.name: CANDYCONC_NO_BROWSER
settings.text: `1` makes `./candyconc` of the application bundle start without opening the browser.
